senses.gloss: ? Kūjaka, n. of a mountain: MSV 〔i.152.12〕. But Divy here Kūlaka, q.v., and earlier Utkūlaka, q.v. (for the latter MSV 〔i.144.16〕 is said to read Kulako in ms., ed. em. Kūjako); and since the ms. has a lacuna covering 〔i.152〕 (see 〔i.149〕, note 1), I presume Kūjaka must be based on Tib. (sgra can? see 〔i.144, n. 2〕).
